newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan trade surplus up in June for 3rd month in row.
newsitem.headline: Japan trade surplus up in June for 3rd month in row.

text.p: Japan's contentious trade surplus jumped for the third successive month in June, rising 27.7 percent from a year earlier to 934.21 billion yen, the Finance Ministry said on Thursday.

The customs-cleared trade surplus with the United States, often a source of friction, soared 26.8 percent in June from a year earlier to 373.14 billion yen. The figures were not adjusted for seasonal factors.
